Name: CP - Giant Crops for Cornucopia More Crops Plus Some Vanilla Crops
Author: MaykellW
Description:
This is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19249]Kobaltbleu's Giant Crop alternative for PPJA Fruits And Veggies[/url]﻿ converted to Content Patcher and retargeted to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url].[b] This is by no means my art. All the credit goes to Kobaltbleu![/b] For the conversion, I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]6480's Giant Crops[/url] as a base. I left some of the original config, so as stated on the original mod page: "[...] you can choose how common giant crops are, and which individual crops you want to enable".

[b]Included Giant Crops[/b]
• Adzuki Bean
• Agave
• Aloe
• Asparagus
• Basil
• Blue Agave
• Cabbage
• Cassava
• Celery
• Chives
• Fennel
• Ginseng
• Lettuce
• Licorice Root
• Mint
• Onion
• Oregano
• Parsley
• Peanut
• Perilla Leaves
• Red Onion
• Rosemary
• Sage
• Shallot
• Spinach
• Sugar Beet
• Sugarcane
• Sweet Potato
• Thyme
• Wasabi Root

[b]Duplicate, Vanilla and Giant Crops[/b]

In addition to Cornucopia More Crops' sprites, Kobaltbleu's files contain sprites for ginger, broccoli, and carrot. These sprites are in a separate zip file. While broccoli and carrots are now part of the base game crops, ginger is also included but will only appear if you have the 'Extended Vanilla Crops' mod installed, as it doesn't have a crop in the vanilla game.

[b]Broccoli
[/b]
6480's Giant Crops already has a giant crop of broccoli and so does this mod. If you have both, you'll have to choose one or another.

[b]Mods Recommendation:
[/b]
I highly recommend 6480's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]Giant Crops[/url] for base game giant crops!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14370]Giant Crops Tweaks[/url]. Aside from its other useful features, it enables by default automatic re-planting upon harvest for regrowing crops.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25029]Giant Flowers for Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]: ﻿Giant Flowers! The Pitcher Plant is my favorite :)
That's all, folks. I hope you enjoy it!

[b]Credits:[/b]
kobaltbleu for the art and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19249]original mod[/url]
6480 for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]Giant Crops[/url] base code
6480 and team for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url]
Pathoschild for Content Patcher
